findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "website_audit" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: [PAID $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Pre-launch website audit: up to 3 pages crawled, 30 links checked, meta/OG/canonical, security head…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: launchcheck_full, page_metadata, url_to_markdown, summarize, text_to_speech, llm_chat, text_embeddings, rerank_documents · Private data: website_audit, generate_image, screenshot_url, base_wallet_balances, base_token_info, base_tx_status, text_embeddings, rerank_documents, crypto_price · Public sink: summarize, text_to_speech, llm_chat, text_embeddings, rerank_documents · Destructive: generate_image, screenshot_url, text_to_speech, llm_chat, text_embeddings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: launchcheck_full, page_metadata, url_to_markdown, summarize, text_to_speech, llm_chat, text_embeddings, rerank_documents · Private data: website_audit, generate_image, screenshot_url, base_wallet_balances, base_token_info, base_tx_status, text_embeddings, rerank_documents, crypto_price · Public sink: summarize, text_to_speech, llm_chat, text_embeddings, rerank_documents · Destructive: generate_image, screenshot_url, text_to_speech, llm_chat, text_embeddings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
